fields.name: Artificial Intelligence
fields.description: Simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems.

fields.name: Machine Learning
fields.description: Study of computer algorithms that improve automatically through experience.

fields.name: Deep Learning
fields.description: Part of a broader family of machine learning methods based on artificial neural networks with representation learning.

fields.name: Natural Language Processing
fields.description: Interaction between computers and human language.

fields.name: Computer Vision
fields.description: How computers can gain high-level understanding from digital images or videos.

fields.name: Biology
fields.description: Natural science that studies life and living organisms.

fields.name: Genetics
fields.description: Study of genes, genetic variation, and heredity in organisms.

fields.name: Genomics
fields.description: Interdisciplinary field of biology focusing on the structure, function, evolution, mapping, and editing of genomes.

fields.name: Bioinformatics
fields.description: Interdisciplinary field that develops methods and software tools for understanding biological data.

fields.name: Single Cell Analysis
fields.description: Study of genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics at the single cell level.

fields.name: Medicine
fields.description: Science and practice of caring for a patient, managing the diagnosis, prognosis, prevention, treatment, palliation of their injury or disease.

fields.name: Oncology
fields.description: Branch of medicine that deals with the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer.

fields.name: Pediatrics
fields.description: Branch of medicine that involves the medical care of infants, children, and adolescents.

fields.name: Neonatology
fields.description: Subspecialty of pediatrics that consists of the medical care of newborn infants, especially the ill or premature newborn.

fields.name: Immunology
fields.description: Study of immune systems in all organisms.

fields.name: Neuroscience
fields.description: Scientific study of the nervous system.
